reconcile.note: Gill reads the refusal in Mark as declining only a sign from heaven, consistent with the many signs already shown and the coming sign of Jonah.

sides.snippet: no sign will be given to this generation.
sides.verseText: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, \"Why does this generation seek a sign? Most assuredly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.\"

sides.snippet: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
